headline: Four Dress Watches That Work With A Suit
stop_reason: Attempt 3: four items verified on official US pages (NOMOS Tangente 38 ref 165 $2,510; Cartier WSTA0106 $4,400; Cartier WSTA0108 $4,100; Grand Seiko SBGW301 $5,000; band within 2x). Engine finish step PASSES. Stopped for owner decision: the Cartier photos on slides 3 and 4 show a lighter rectangle behind the watch, which the owner has disliked (white boxes behind watch photos). Also: Cartier models are marked Unavailable online in the US, and the Grand Seiko and Cartier photos are from official media (rights: official). Longines and Omega were dropped (Longines price not verified from an official page; Omega US list $6,400 is above the band).
